 UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 at upessc.up.gov.in: Direct Link To Download Hall Ticket
 By Manish Kumar Last Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 14:07 IST UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 is expected to be released soon by the Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) for 1,936 Assistant Professor posts. The written exam is scheduled to be held across 81 centers located in six divisional headquarters on November 19 and 20, 2026. Check the steps to download the hall ticket and more details here. 
 UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 at upessc.up.gov.in: Direct Link To Download Hall Ticket 
 UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) is expected to release the UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026. The written exam for the 1,936 Assistant Professor posts in non-government aided colleges in Uttar Pradesh to be held  on  November  19 and 20, 2026 . The written exam will be conducted across 81 centers located in six divisional headquarters of the state. Earlier, the exam authority had released the City Slip on November 08, 2026, on the official website.
 Once released, candidates will be able to download the Admit Card for the UP Assistant Professor position through the candidates' login section on the official website www.upessc.up.gov.in.
 UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 Date  
 The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has not disclosed any specific date for the release of UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 on its official website. The written exam is scheduled to be held on November 19 and 20, 2026.  As per general practice, the exam authority is expected to release the admit card today on its official website. Candidates can download their hall ticket by visiting the link provided on the homepage of the Commission's website and entering the required details.  
 UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026: Know The Things To Avoid
 Candidates appearing in the written exam for the posts of Assistant Professor should note that they will have to follow the guidelines mentioned on the Admit Card before and after entering in the exam hall. Candidates will be subjected to frisking to ensure that they are not carrying any electronic or other gadgets as mentioned in the notification. No electronic gadgets will be allowed to be carried inside the exam so you should abstain from carrying such items, including Mobile / Cellular Phones, Tablets, Pen Drives. Bluetooth Devices, Wristwatches, Watch Calculators, Log Tables, Wallets, Purses, Notes, Charts, loose sheets or recording instruments strapped to the body or in the pockets. 
 UPESSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 Download Link 
 Once available, candidates can download the UPESSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026  from the official website by clicking on the "Admit Card Download" button. You will have to use your login credentials, including Registration Number/Mobile Number and Date of Birth, to access the link. You can download the UP Assistant Professor City Slip 2026 directly through the link given below- 
 UP Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 Download Link (Active soon)   
 UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam 2026 Pattern
 The selection for the Assistant Professor will be based on a total of 360 marks, comprising a written examination and an interview round. The exam will be held across 6 divisional headquarters of the state, including Agra, Meerut, Gorakhpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj, and Varanasi. The exam will be conducted in two shifts daily i.e. morning (09:30 AM to 11:30 AM) and afternoon (02:30 PM to 04:30 PM). Check the details of the exam pattern below-
 Particulars  Details  
 Written Examination 360 marks  
 Total Questions 120 
 Exam mode  Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) 
 General Knowledge 30 questions
 Relevant Subject 90 questions
